title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S6 E5 — The Little Things
Jail stays are getting longer and many inmates have very little, leading to violence erupting over any perceived slight, especially if it involves food.

title: Lockup: Tampa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Bitter Pills
An inmate with a long record runs an extortion scheme, while drugs inside the jail pose a lethal threat; the jail's newest team member makes her presence known.

title: Lockup: Oakland: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — The New Girl
Deputies respond to rising tensions in a female housing unit; a popular rapper, whose ups and downs have been told in the Oakland media, now faces serious charges; a grandmother convicted of a mortgage scam finds her place in the inmate hierarchy.

title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Crackdown
When Travis Trani took charge in 2008 he oversaw the implementation of several new policies; the restrictions on movement were among the toughest; inmates from the six different housing units could no longer freely move throughout the prison.

title: Lockup: Cleveland: Extended Stay
description:
S16 E6 — Checkmate
The tenth floor of Cuyahoga County Correction Center contains the Special Response Team, or SERT, a tactical unit trained in the use of riot gear, non-lethal weapons and controlling high-risk inmates.

title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Blood Lines
An inmate takes drastic action and leaves his cell in a bloody mess; dangerous contraband is found on another inmate at Florida's Santa Rosa Correctional Institution.

title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Troubled Waters
A massive search for contraband throughout the facility turns up the heat on two inmates inside the Santa Rosa Correctional Institution; a convict prompts an evacuation when he floods his housing unit.

title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Unholy Trinity
Every year, close to 70,000 people are processed through the five facilities that make up the Orange County Jail in Southern California; some will call the jail home until their cases are resolved in court - a process that can take years.

title: Lockup: Fairfax: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — The Crip and the Cougar
A gang member with a violent past and a long disciplinary record in jail tries to convince staff he's changed; another inmate, once a victim of prison rape, lobbies to do his time in isolation.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Sticks and Stone
Wabash Valley Correctional Facility houses some of the highest security prisoners in the state; corrections staff investigate a potential escape plot and one inmate with a very familiar face tells their own story.

title: Lockup: Savannah: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Bloodlines
A jail program attempts to save shelter dogs from being put down; an Army veteran must face his own demons; pregnant and charged with murder, one inmate must decide whether to turn in a family member to save herself.
